review_evidence: LeroyCompilerVerificationCourse/Imp.lean defines arithmetic/boolean expressions, commands, big-step and small-step semantics, divergence/wrongness notions, and proves progress and semantics-equivalence results.
Constprop.lean proves soundness of arithmetic/boolean simplification and terminating constant-propagation correctness; Deadcode.lean proves liveness properties and dead-code-elimination correctness.
Compil.lean defines a stack-machine compiler and proves compile_aexp_correct, compile_bexp_correct, terminating compiler correctness, and simulation theorems.
summary: Retain the Leroy compiler-verification course as a substantive formal development of IMP semantics, optimizations, compilation, fixpoints, and correctness proofs.
